title: Control 1.1: Restrict Agent Publishing by Authorization

checks.description: Environment Maker role not assigned to All Users
Agent publisher security group exists (FSI-Agent-Publishers-Prod)
Share with Everyone disabled across environments

name: Restrict Agent Publishing by Authorization
yesBar: Environment Maker role removed from All Users; named publisher security group exists; share-with-everyone disabled and agent publish gated by approval workflow across Zone 2/3 environments.
partialBar: Publisher security group exists but Environment Maker still includes broad groups, or share-with-everyone disabled in only some environments.
noBar: Environment Maker is open to All Users, no publisher security group exists, and agents can be shared with everyone without approval.

facilitatorNotes.ask: Is publishing in production environments restricted to a named publisher security group with approval, and is share-with-everyone disabled?
facilitatorNotes.followUp: Open Power Platform admin center > Environments > [Prod] > Settings > Users + permissions, then PPAC > Tenant settings > Sharing.

title: Control 1.2: Agent Registry and Integrated Apps Management

checks.description: Agent inventory maintained with all agents registered
Authentication mode configured per agent
No orphaned agents (all have active owner)

name: Agent Registry and Integrated Apps Management
yesBar: All agents and integrated apps registered with named owner and backup owner, admin consent workflow enabled, and no orphaned service principals across Entra, Integrated Apps, and Copilot Studio.
partialBar: Inventory exists for some surfaces (e.g., Integrated Apps) but Copilot Studio or Entra Agent ID coverage is incomplete or owner attribution is missing for Zone 2/3 agents.
noBar: No tenant-wide agent inventory; user consent unrestricted; orphaned or unowned service principals exist with no remediation workflow.

facilitatorNotes.ask: Do you maintain a single registry of all agents and integrated apps with named owners, sponsors, and approved permission scopes?
facilitatorNotes.followUp: Check M365 admin center > Settings > Integrated apps, Entra > Enterprise applications, and the Copilot Studio agent list.

manual_question: Have site permission reviews been completed in the last 90 days for all agent knowledge sources?

yesBar: External sharing restricted; Everyone groups removed from agent knowledge sites; container sensitivity labels applied; SAM RAC/RCD enabled and quarterly access reviews active for Zone 3.
partialBar: Tenant sharing restricted but agent knowledge sites still grant Everyone-except-external or lack sensitivity labels and SAM controls.
noBar: External sharing wide open, knowledge sites contain Everyone groups, no sensitivity labels, and no access reviews on agent-grounded SharePoint content.

facilitatorNotes.ask: Are SharePoint sites used as agent knowledge sources scoped with least-privilege permissions, sensitivity labels, and RAC/RCD where appropriate?
facilitatorNotes.followUp: Open SharePoint admin center > Policies > Sharing, then review per-site permissions and SAM Data Access Governance reports.

noBar: No ACP, no DLP connector classification, and Copilot Studio agents can use any connector including consumer cloud storage and social media.
